To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have identified a genome-wide significant single nucleotide polymorphism (rs1052373) in MYBPC3 (myosin binding protein C, cardiac muscle, slow type) gene associated with endurance athlete and endurance performance status.
we have identified a SNP in the MYBPC3 gene that is associated with endurance athlete performance.
we have discovered a novel association of the MYBPC3 gene polymorphism, endurance athlete status, aerobic capacity and steroid metabolism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of genetic and metabolic markers for elite endurance athlete status.
the identification of the genetic and biochemical factors associated with endurance athlete performance.
the identification of the genetic factors associated with elite endurance athlete status and the elucidation of the underlying mechanisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the identified genetic variants and metabolites are associated with endurance athlete phenotype and are not causal for elite endurance athlete status.
this study provides a novel genetic marker for elite endurance athlete status.
the genetic component to elite athlete performance is a reality, and that the genetic predisposition to endurance sports may have a significant contribution to the elite athlete status.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MYBPC3 gene and its associated metabolites are important in the regulation of endurance athlete status and aerobic capacity.
the genetic background of endurance athletes is associated with the steroid metabolism.
a novel association was found between MYBPC3 gene polymorphism, endurance athlete status, aerobic capacity and steroid metabolism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genetic predisposition to endurance athletic performance is associated with the genetic predisposition of cardiac hypertrophic myopathies.
the MYBPC3 gene is a novel candidate for the genetic predisposition to high-level endurance athletic performance.
the MYBPC3 gene polymorphism rs1052373 may play an important role in the regulation of aerobic capacity and steroid metabolism in endurance athletes.
